title: Smart Annotator — annotation pack
description: Exported by the 'JSON' button. Open format: original content, every annotation with its anchor, and region screenshots. Consume it with your own pipeline instead of Claude if you prefer.

version.description: Pack format version. v3 packs carry a single document at the top level instead of docs[]; readers should accept both.

lang.description: UI language the pack was exported in.

prompt.description: The ready-to-send brief the tool generated. Convenience only — everything needed to rebuild it is in docs[].

format.description: Format of the annotatable VIEW (not necessarily of originalFile).

original.description: Source of the view. May be omitted/empty when 'send notes only' was used for a large source.

originalFile.description: Present when the view was converted from a binary file. Revisions should be written back to THIS file, preserving its format.

uiShot.description: true = the document is a screenshot of a UI; apply the notes to the source code that produces it, not to the image.

kind.description: selection = highlighted text; block = whole paragraph/cell; region = dragged box over a visual area.

quote.description: The annotated text. For 'region' this is a placeholder summary; use snippetHTML instead.

comment.description: What the human wants changed. May be empty.

anchor.description: Machine-readable location. Prefer this over text matching when present.

ref.description: cell: A1-style address, optionally sheet-qualified and possibly a range. page: page label. block: tag#index.

rect.description: region only — box geometry relative to the rendered view.

snippetHTML.description: region only — the underlying HTML the box covered. This is what lets a model edit the right markup.

thumb.description: region only — PNG data URL of the boxed area. Feed to a multimodal model so it can SEE the visual.
